reviews.title: Great app. Optimized for Apple Watch
reviews.text:
I’ve been using this app since the beginning. It’s still the best by far! 

Great data, accurate, and consistent updates and improvements. The text messaging and live tracking to family provides a huge level of reassurance when I’m paddling open ocean or long runs. 

This is the one you want for SUP training or just logging your adventures!

reviews.title: You wanted a review as soon as I signed up so you get one.
reviews.text: I am not real excited about this app so far.  It only measure in metric.  I can figure it out, but it would be nice to have a way to switch.  Would also be nice to be able to actually use the app without having to give you my credit card information and pay you for a year for my free week trial.  I will have to remember to cancel it.  I used your app one time before to test it out.  Was not impressed.  Maybe it is worth $29.   If not.  I will cancel it after this evenings paddle.  Maybe set your model up to let your customers try the full suite and then ask them to pay, but what the do I know.   I am gonna try it out this evening.  If it works ok, you can have my money this year.  Hope it impresses me.  I have not been so far.

reviews.title: A “Must Have” App!!!
reviews.text: I absolutely LOVE the Paddle Logger app! I started getting into kayaking and SUP end of Jan 2024. Someone suggested that I download this app. I love seeing how many sessions that I have logged, the split times, the mileage I’ve logged, the route that it displays I took, safety features I have access to (contacting others if I don’t return from a scheduled trip) etc.! I’ve been able to beat my 1 mile race time, time & time again and have pushed myself to hit certain mileage goals per trip. If you’re interested in all of the above, you must download this app! Happy paddling!

reviews.title: Great app.. Except
reviews.text:
Overall, I enjoy using this app. I moved over from PaddleWays and have used this ever since. My biggest problem with this app is the end-of-session button. Twice now I’ve hit the distress button, causing unnecessary stress for the people on my call list. There should be a clear button on the app to end the session away from the emergency button. It’s not well laid out. Please fix. 

Update 7/14/26
The App developer contacted me, stating they are working on an update to the distress button location. Thank you for responding! I will continue to use this app and look forward to the update.

reviews.title: This app got really GOOD!
reviews.text:
I’m one of the OG app purchasers, I’ve been here since v1 was released. It’s always been my favorite paddle tracker because it’s truly designed for paddleboarders, it’s not one of those fitness apps that added SUP as an afterthought. This app is FOR PADDLEBOARDING and I love it for understanding our workouts and what we expect to track. My wife loves it because it notifies her where i am and if I’m on time or not (or alive!). 

This latest version is AMAZING. One button workout starts, health app syncing, ranking and stats from all your paddles from the beginning of time, syncing photos to your map, it’s awesome and fun. 

This is my only paddle app these days, it does everything I need for paddle tracking, emergency notifications, stats, workout reviews, you name it. This is the app for us.

reviews.text: I had an issue with the watch face freezing up getting locked in water lock mode. Contacted customer support and Holly replied very quickly. She researched the issue and stayed with me. Until it was resolved, easy, quick fix. Thank you, Holly and Paddle Logger.

reviews.title: Awesome for Kayakers
reviews.text:
I’ve only used this app for a short while, but I’m here to tell you, this is a great app, especially if you will be going on the water solo! The app lets you make a float plan that you can share with others in real time as you paddle. No need to worry about getting off course because the app is awesome about making sure you know when you’re headed the wrong way! Don’t go in the water without this app, seriously! 

PS - I didn’t give it five stars because there is a map feature missing when making a float plan that I feel definitely needs to be added. But it was easy to talk to them about adding the feature, which they said they would work on. Very easy team to communicate with if you have questions or suggestions.

reviews.title: Keeps getting better!
reviews.text: So many features that make this app great, but the ability to edit sessions means I don’t have to stress about ending the session but can go back later and edit it to stop when I hit the dock. Awesome!

reviews.title: Awesome App
reviews.text: This has been my go-to app for kayaking for a few years now. The tracking and logbook are great and I also love the safety features built in. I go out alone fairly often and my wife worries less knowing she can live track where I am and gets notifications when I start and stop along with an automatic notification if I don’t check in every so often. That alone is well worth the subscription cost.

reviews.title: San Diego Yaking
reviews.text:
Got the app to track  kayaking in Mission Bay in San Diego. I’m kayaking in the bay for performance and I need something which shows performance with detailed splits. I typically do 9 to 12 kilometers and the App gives me the splits in meters per hour, over all time and performance and shows the real overview from a google earth style view, along with a maps view. 

It makes the entire experience of kayaking, a similar track every time more interesting especially when the wind is blowing, and the waves are a little choppy. This gives you the opportunity to have a lot more data available if so, desired, I highly recommend this app.

But this summer it has been terrible: it closes itself too easily in the middle of my paddle and there’s no way to resume. Just touching the screen at all as I am flipping to my camera screen, for example, is enough to close it. I am nowhere near the Pause or End buttons! On my Monday paddle it did it TWICE! I am sick of this, I’m out.

reviews.title: Safety First - Safety Always - Safety Safety Safety 🛟
reviews.text:
Ever wish those concerned family members and friends would get off your back with those annoying questions when you’re paddling? 

Ya know, those pesky little things that matter like, ‘Where are you?’ And, ‘Are you safe?’

Now, all you need to do is download Paddle Logger. 

Seriously, it’s as easy as downloading, creating your account, selecting a few choice contacts and hitting the big fat GO button. 

Guess what? 

It’s even easier on your second use…just hit GO! 🤯

In addition to being safe and calming your loved one’s nerves, you can even make a Paddle Plan. 

I know! 

A real life PLAN so everyone can be in the same page. 

Are you one of those who likes keeping their social media followers up to date about your latest acquatic adventures? 

Paddle Logger has you covered. 

Share your paddle everywhere with YOUR photos or a super high def map of your route with your splits. 

Go ahead, 💪 those stats.

Don’t risk it! 

It’s as easy as hitting GO!

It’s your digital life jacket 🛟 don’t hit the water without it.
